I answered Dana in her #north-team thread: the 2026 renewal at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **261 seats**.

- **Source:** Ilse posted that figure in #north-team on Oct 14. No one has corrected it in the channel since then.
- **Which channel I checked:** I only read #north-team, after confirming Dana is a member.
- **Possible mix-up:** I also told Dana that the 185 from August 2025 is a different number. It's the seat count under Amendment No. 1, which she corrected from 180 at the time. It isn't the 2026 renewal figure.
